title: Kawaii/Cute
content: Apply kawaii/cute Japanese aesthetic with adorable elements. Use soft pastel colors: pink-200, sky-200, yellow-200, lavender. Add cute character faces to icons and illustrations (simple dots for eyes, small curves for mouths). Extra-rounded corners (rounded-3xl, rounded-full). Include decorative elements: stars, hearts, sparkles, clouds, rainbows. Use playful, rounded fonts. Add subtle bounce animations on interaction. Create sticker-like elements with white borders. Emphasize positive emotions and friendliness.

variants.simple: Create adorable Japanese kawaii style with cute characters, pastel colors, and rounded shapes.
variants.detailed: Apply kawaii/cute Japanese aesthetic with adorable elements. Use soft pastel colors: pink-200, sky-200, yellow-200, lavender. variants.advanced: Apply kawaii/cute Japanese aesthetic with adorable, friendly design language. Color palette: soft pastels - sakura pink (pink-200, pink-300), sky blue (sky-200), butter yellow (yellow-200), mint (green-200), lavender (violet-200). Character elements: simple face expressions on icons/mascots - dot eyes, small curved mouth, rosy cheek circles (can be CSS pseudo-elements). Shape language: extremely rounded (rounded-3xl, rounded-full), soft, puffy shapes like clouds. Decorative elements: sparkle/star clusters (SVG or Unicode ✦✧★), hearts, small clouds, rainbow arcs, confetti dots. Typography: extra-rounded fonts (Nunito, Quicksand, Varela Round), consider Japanese-style with slight bounce. Animation: subtle bounce on hover (scale + translateY spring animation), floating motion for decorative elements, sparkle twinkle effects. Sticker aesthetic: elements with white border/shadow appearing as applied stickers. Speech bubbles: cute rounded chat bubbles with small tails. Buttons: pill-shaped with subtle gradient and face expressions or emoji. Background patterns: polka dots, tiny stars, subtle grid. Icons: rounded stroke style with happy expressions added. Sound/interaction: consider adding satisfying micro-interactions. Borders: soft, thick borders in slightly darker pastel. Accessibility: ensure pastels meet contrast requirements, faces dont interfere with usability. Target audience: casual apps, children, wellness, gaming.
